metadata.bookend_exempt_reason: Pitch film, not an explainer: opens on its own title beat (BOPEN) and question beat (BIDEA), both Manim; no verdict card (show-tell drops it); no Your Turn, because a pitch has no viewer task and a Claude.ai-styled composer would look like a Claude exchange that never happened. No terms card, to stay inside 2-4 minutes. The outro stays, credited to the author.

beats.narration_text: I picked it because I'm job hunting too, and I wanted a smarter strategy than a hundred-plus applications a day. It's a mix. What I can show is judgment, not code: Claude Code wrote most of the prototype; I set its rules, like requiring recent funding, and signed its human gates. New for me: evaluation, and resolving boards at scale.
